itens.trecho: Refinado e elegante, não é aconselhável a quem procura o riso fácil. Este foi o meu primeiro contacto com a obra de Wes Anderson e, pelo pouco que conheço agora (este filme), acredito que posso concordar com a opinião geral de que o director é bom, competente e intelectual, brindando-nos com filmes muito bons mas que são um pouco difíceis de descrever em…

Wes Anderson's THE GRAND BUDAPEST HOTEL is the director's celebration of Central Europe culture and fashion in the years between the World Wars, and an elegy for what was lost with the rise of fascism and communism.

Wonderfully poetic, based on the fantastic work of the Austrian Jewish novelist Stefan Zweig, who in 1940 fled to Petrópolis, Brazil, where he died at the age of 60 (1942), I love these tales with retro photography, agile and fun narration, a small investigative mystery, with extra doses of drama, tragic and funny, makes us laugh and moves us, excellent…
